name: Docchi no Ane ga Ii no!? ~Yureru Futatsu no Kokoro~
original_name: どっちの姉がいいの!?～ユレルフタツノココロ～
source:
Masaki's older sister, Miyuki, was involved in a traffic accident.
She hit her head hard and was unconscious for two days, but thanks to the Masaki's care, she was able to be released from the hospital just one week later.
The night he was released from the hospital, Miyuki suddenly tried to rape him.
Masaki was carried away and ended up having sex with her.
Thinking something was wrong, he talked to her, and found out that the aftereffects had left her with a split personality.
Which older sister will you choose: the same old ``big sister'' or the sexy ``big sister''?
translation:
正树的姐姐未幸遭遇交通事故，头部受到重创，昏迷了两天。在正树悉心照料下，她仅一周便获准出院。

出院当晚，未幸突然试图强暴弟弟。正树被气氛裹挟，最终与她发生了性关系。察觉姐姐不太对劲后，他与她交谈，才得知事故后遗症让她产生了双重人格。

你会选择哪一个姐姐：一如往常的“大姐姐”，还是性感奔放的“大姐姐”？
